text:
Advisors Capital Management LLC grew its position in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 2.3% in the 2nd quarter, according to its most recent disclosure with the Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC). The fund owned 108,758 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after acquiring an additional 2,443 shares during the quarter. Apple comprises 1.4% of Advisors Capital Management LLC’s portfolio, making the stock its 12th biggest position. Advisors Capital Management LLC’s holdings in Apple were worth $20,132,000 at the end of the most recent quarter.
A number of other large investors have also recently made changes to their positions in the business. Captrust Financial Advisors boosted its position in shares of Apple by 16.1% in the second quarter. Captrust Financial Advisors now owns 169,033 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $31,290,000 after buying an additional 23,456 shares during the period. Peak Capital Management LLC purchased a new stake in shares of Apple in the second quarter worth about $5,580,000. Commonwealth Bank of Australia boosted its position in shares of Apple by 9.2% in the second quarter. Commonwealth Bank of Australia now owns 488,687 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $90,121,000 after buying an additional 40,989 shares during the period. Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. boosted its position in shares of Apple by 149.3% in the second quarter. Itau Unibanco Holding S.A. now owns 644,086 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $119,220,000 after buying an additional 385,707 shares during the period. Finally, Ropes Wealth Advisors LLC boosted its position in shares of Apple by 2.9% in the second quarter. Ropes Wealth Advisors LLC now owns 71,003 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $13,143,000 after buying an additional 2,010 shares during the period. Shares of NASDAQ AAPL opened at $168.49 on Monday. Apple Inc. has a 52-week low of $150.24 and a 52-week high of $233.47. The company has a market cap of $828.15 billion, a price-to-earnings ratio of 14.15, a PEG ratio of 1.21 and a beta of 1.20. The company has a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.87, a quick ratio of 1.09 and a current ratio of 1.12.
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, November 1st. The iPhone maker reported $2.91 earnings per share for the quarter, topping analysts’ consensus estimates of $2.78 by $0.13. The business had revenue of $62.90 billion for the quarter, compared to analysts’ expectations of $61.55 billion. Apple had a return on equity of 48.68% and a net margin of 22.41%. The business’s quarterly revenue was up 19.6% on a year-over-year basis. During the same period in the prior year, the firm earned $2.07 EPS. As a group, equities research analysts predict that Apple Inc. will post 13.32 EPS for the current fiscal year.
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, November 15th. Stockholders of record on Monday, November 12th were given a dividend of $0.73 per share. This represents a $2.92 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.73%. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Thursday, November 8th. Apple’s payout ratio is 24.52%.
A number of brokerages recently commented on AAPL. Wells Fargo & Co set a $210.00 price target on Apple and gave the company a “neutral” rating in a report on Monday, October 1st. Oppenheimer reissued a “neutral” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, October 1st. Morgan Stanley reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $245.00 price target (up previously from $232.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. DA Davidson reissued a “buy” rating and issued a $265.00 price target (up previously from $230.00) on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, September 5th. Finally, DZ Bank reissued a “buy” rating on shares of Apple in a report on Monday, September 3rd. Four analysts have rated the stock with a sell rating, twenty-three have issued a hold rating and twenty-four have issued a buy rating to the company. The company presently has an average rating of “Hold” and a consensus target price of $219.47.
In other news, insider Luca Maestri sold 100,245 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Thursday, October 4th. The stock was sold at an average price of $228.56, for a total transaction of $22,911,997.20. Following the sale, the insider now directly owns 91,665 shares in the company, valued at approximately $20,950,952.40. The sale was disclosed in a legal filing with the Securities & Exchange Commission, which can be accessed through the SEC website . Also, SVP Angela J. Ahrendts sold 25,000 shares of the stock in a transaction that occurred on Wednesday, October 3rd. The stock was sold at an average price of $232.66, for a total value of $5,816,500.00. Following the sale, the senior vice president now owns 105,538 shares in the company, valued at $24,554,471.08. The disclosure for this sale can be found here . Insiders have sold a total of 204,845 shares of company stock worth $47,015,677 over the last quarter. Insiders own 0.08% of the company’s stock.
Apple Profile
Apple Inc designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, and personal computers. It also sells various related software, services, accessories, and third-party digital content and applications. The company offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers, as well as iOS, macOS, watchOS, and tvOS operating systems.
